method.teacher_system: The teacher breaks the running man down into four micro-movements, teaching each component slowly with repetition and clear mechanics before combining them into the full step.
method.signature: Breaking down the running man into four distinct isolated components (perch forward-back, flat foot split, weighted hop-back, and full combination)

practices.what: Introduce step one called the perch forward back, standing on one foot with the other knee in a tabletop position.
Demonstrate and repeat the perch forward and back movement on the other side.
Introduce step two called the two-footed flat foot split, hopping to land both feet at the same time.
Introduce step three called the weighted foot hop-back, practicing hopping backward on a single foot.
Alternate the hop back across both feet repeatedly to build muscle memory.
Introduce step four, putting all components together into the full running man.

adaptations.difficulty: Lack of ankle strength or confidence to jump backward
adaptations.adjustment: Use a wall or a chair for support while practicing the hop back

beliefs.belief: Feeling fearful or unconfident in a new move is 100 percent normal when ankle strength is still developing.

feelings.response: The teacher explains that lacking confidence in a move is 100 percent normal and offers a chair or wall for support.
Explain that feeling fearful or unconfident about the hop-back move is 100% normal due to ankle strength.

moments.says: The teacher welcomes viewers looking to master the running man, introducing a step-by-step tutorial for those who struggled previously.
The teacher reassures learners that feeling fearful about ankle strength in backward hops is completely normal and suggests using a wall or chair for support.
The teacher reviews all previously learned components before guiding the learner to put them together.
The teacher invites viewers to explore hundreds of free tutorials on YouTube or visit midlifeshuffle.com for personalized instruction.

mentor.what_stays: The teacher leaves the learner feeling capable of mastering a difficult dance move through patience and structured breakdown.

struggles.theme: Difficulty remembering moves and fast talking instructors
Terrible balance and lack of dance ability
Landing both feet at the same time incorrectly
Finding the running man difficult after trying for a long time

clicked.theme: Breaking the move down into bite-sized micro movements
Mentioning that feet should land at different times or together
Showing the moves from multiple angles and slow speed

meant.theme: Feeling proud and surprised at being able to do it at an older age
Finding joy, fun, and increased fitness through learning to shuffle

method.limits: The video is a tutorial format without real-time interaction or live feedback from students.
